title: smime-tree: expect() calls in production code — encrypt.rs and sign.rs
description: Four .expect('key is exactly N bytes') calls in encrypt_aes_cbc lambda (encrypt.rs:143,145,153,155) and .expect() on from_utf8 in sign.rs:359 and encrypt.rs:538. All are provably unreachable but violate the convention of no panics in production code. Replace with unreachable!() or restructure to use fixed-size arrays.
